Name: Museum-Worthy Spoon
Author: AirynS
Description:
A tiny mod born of a joke in the East Scarp server, this mod simply edits the rusty spoon artifact’s description so that instead of being an item with no historical value that’s younger than everyone except Jas & Vincent, it’s an artifact that might actually be worth putting in a museum.

To install, simply download, extract the “[CP] Museum-Worthy Spoon” folder, and drop it in your Mods folder.

Incompatible with any mods that edit the spoon description, which as far as I’m aware is only Unsettling Item Descriptions and in which case you probably want that mod’s description over this one anyway.
